Title: Ability to Diagnose and resolve hybrid identity directory errors is now available

Body.Content:
Identify and remediate directory errors caused by duplicate user attributes and orphaned objects, which complicate synchronizing your AD and Azure AD hybrid identity environment.  Errors and resolutions are directly surfaced and actionable within the Azure AD portal.

Learn more
